questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: For me it was the historical importance of the city and i wish to sudy the culture of spain further so cordoba were the perfect choice

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: it was very difficult, most of the information i got from other students

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I had some help from the office of international relations, at the campus

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was not that difficult, i find my accomidation through Interasmundo, wich is quite good

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: They need to be prepared to be social since often you will share yout flat with other people, and it helps with the study experience that you have a good environment at home

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: It was very hard to figure out the system and how it worked but once i got a hang off it, i could esealy chose the universeties and clases i wanted

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: We had some clases that helped us to prepare for the trip and how it worked, but it was not a lot

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: That ended up very good, all my clases got accepted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Talk to your fellow studentes and ask for help if anything seems confusing, and also you can contact the university directly if you are having problems

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The academic level was to my liking but, the way the courses went on seemed a bit old school. I am not a fan of how the exams were handled aswell. Mostly it seemed i just had to remember a lot of stuff and not use the knowledge i had gained in class

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Very different, at UCPH we not only learn and get information about a topic but we thought how ti use it aswell, here the profesor mostly talked during for the whole hour wich was a bit dissapoiting, and i prefer the teaching style of UCPH

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Teoria y practica del español 
Variacion linquistica 
Historia Moderna universal, politica cultura 
Histora Medieval universal siglos de XI a XV
Literatura hispanica de los siglos XX y XXI

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: The history courses were very interesting, especiallyhistoria moderna universal, aslo variacion linquistica is a very interesting subject but it is a bit difficult

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Swimming, and some speaches and events and so fourth, also some workshops.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: La mezquita (Cathedral in cordoba) pretty much all of the old city, also i recommend to take a trip to sevilla and/or Malaga and granada all very interesting cities that are worth checking out

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go out and have some dinner with other erasmus students or like i mentioned before take a trip to a city or do something in the city centre. Cordoba have a lot of great resuturants wich are worth to experince

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: I found it pretty easy the accent can be though, but i already had some experince with andalucia

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Try to speak as much spanish as possible, they will help you if you are having trouble

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: I did not find any cultural differences challenging

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The people and how most people in andalucia are more laid back than in denmark and in some ways more open to strangers

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Prepare for a change in education and how it works 
Ask your teaches for adivice on the first day, they can help adjust to the subjects and style of educcation 
Remember to have fun aswell, it is okay to go see some freinds once in a while

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Cordoba is a very warm city so be prepared for some crazy temperatures in june/juli maybe even may

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: That i could live the language i am studing, wich means that i experience the culture first hand, and also get a rutine going down here has been very rewarding to me. Also the challenge of doing something new and fresh has been very nice

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: For me it was to adjust to the way clases and the edcation worked i never really got used to it fully and i regret that

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: None other than i recommend to take an semester abroad if you fell like it, it is one of the most interesting and fun experiences of your youth in my opinion

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
